subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed with a proven union_id source, switch to another cross-app identity strategy, or be superseded by broader Feishu bot-to-bot identity work?
rationale: The bug path is source-backed, but the submitted identity source is disputed and the merge would affect message admission semantics where automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this branch as investigation context and close or replace it only after a broader Feishu identity PR lands with positive proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainership can deliberately accept the union_id fallback only with proof that it populates and focused tests for sibling paths.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and have recent Feishu mention-path history relevant to this decision.
